chapters.name: 书桌一角
chapters.detail: A bookish stationery and study lane. On the left a honey-wood bookshop with tall arched windows and a blue-and-cream striped awning displaying journals and pencil cups. In the middle a low open-air reading pavilion and outdoor desks with neat stacks of notebooks, small fountain pen stall and a giant wooden pencil sign with no words. On the right an ivy-clad library nook with cream stone steps and closed pastel books. Framing with ginkgo trees and tiny soft yellow leaves. A continuous pale parchment-colored stone road runs LEFT TO RIGHT along the LOWER MIDDLE, around y60%-68%, gently rising to y58% near center then down again. Small planted flowerbeds and a dry shallow stone-lined garden at bottom instead of a river. Soft morning light, sage and robin-egg blue, warm paper ivory. Distinctive peaceful scholarly setting. Buildings mostly in top 50%, road clearly walkable and empty.

A tiny covered wooden delivery platform farther up-right. Carefully designed brick architecture, small yellow autumn shrubs, NO river or bridge. A continuous wide warm cobbled road along y62%-68% links all storefronts from left to right, gently curving upward near center to y57%. Framing bottom edge with a low stone curb, flowerpots and parcel carts that stay off the road. Late Saturday morning sunshine, brick red, faded postal blue and caramel wood. No logos or letters on parcels or walls.
